name: More countdowns
author: Clippy
description: Four more kinds of Top countdown: most awkward, best comebacks, most relatable and most inspiring moments.

countdown_themes.name: Most awkward
countdown_themes.title: Top {n} Most Awkward Moments
countdown_themes.look_for: the most awkward moments: uncomfortable silences, cringe questions, people saying the wrong thing, things that make viewers want to look away

countdown_themes.name: Best comebacks
countdown_themes.title: Top {n} Best Comebacks
countdown_themes.look_for: the best comebacks and roasts: quick, witty or savage replies that shut someone down

countdown_themes.name: Most relatable
countdown_themes.title: Top {n} Most Relatable Moments
countdown_themes.look_for: the most relatable moments: everyday struggles, honest confessions and "that's so me" situations most viewers have lived through

countdown_themes.name: Most inspiring
countdown_themes.title: Top {n} Most Inspiring Moments
countdown_themes.look_for: the most inspiring moments: hard-won lessons, comeback stories and lines that make people want to go and do something
